base_pigment_repair.medium_grain_source: Existing relief-height field, bandpass radii 2 and 12, clipped to +/-0.25 in log height; excludes the invalid pigment imprint.
base_pigment_repair.method: Interpolate log pigment from adjacent wood through the highlight-shaped invalid region, adding bounded fine reference grain. Broad reference brightness is excluded. Existing hidden-surface coverage and all unmasked pigment are retained.

base_reflector_color_fit.method: Fresh real BSDF baseline and isolated base light, fitted through AgX. Only the actual light color and power change; no beauty compositing.

base_reflector_refinement.method: Move the physical rectangular emitter along a reflected view ray, narrowing and lengthening it according to measured reference glint moments. No geometry or material change.

base_transition_refinement.method: Cubic Hermite radius through rings 25-29, matching the incoming flare slope and ending tangent to the socket cylinder. Only radii of rings 26-29 change; all heights, other controls, camera, UVs, material and lights are retained.

bowl_arc_fit.method: Full colored wood BSDF response per real linked light, fit through AgX; fixed remaining rig, geometry and material.

bowl_reflection_trial.method: Physical spot lights aimed by reflected camera rays at reference glints; material and geometry unchanged.

caveat: Art-directed light powers; approximate diffuse/specular separation and low-resolution basis. Requires a full render and visual verification.

combined_base_refinement.method: Combine only independently inspected changes: smooth base/socket junction, local pigment repair, and warmer reshaped base reflector. Exclude rejected multi-light confinement.

finial_receiver_isolation.method: The unchanged closed control mesh is exported to the viewer. Two exact evaluated render receivers preserve its UVs and smooth normals. Only the intended three finial spots can reflect directly on the finial; other accepted reflectors keep their original powers on the turned body.

grain_contrast_trial.caveat: Reference grain is inferred with bounded local shading contamination. Hidden surfaces retain continuous prior wood; source images are unchanged.

inference.caveat: Low-frequency inferred color is preserved; some carving or shading edges may enter the bounded detail field. Highlight grain is suppressed, not painted into a reflective light map. Hidden surfaces retain prior continuous wood.
inference.method: Retain a broad normalized pigment field; replace coarse invented color lines with bounded fine/medium log-luminance variation from the unchanged reference

measured_pigment.caveat: Approximate inverse pigment under inferred geometry and lighting; residual shading can remain.

feedback.method: One measured actual-BSDF correction after the black/white approximation; existing confidence excludes strong reflections.

measured_pigment.method: (reference-linear minus measured black BSDF) / measured white-minus-black response; exclude strong reflections and boundary pixels. Packed pigment/confidence are separate; actual BSDF/normal/roughness/lights are retained.
measured_pigment.projection: Fixed world-space orthographic camera; original visible-surface coverage; hidden surfaces keep the accepted atlas

method: Combine roundtrip-verified 057 fine pigment with 054 expanded display-fitted reflection rig

pigment_grading.method: Regional median RGB discrepancies, corrected in linear pigment; artistic inference, not recovered albedo

reflector_spread_trial.hypothesis: Prevent the tall base reflector from also drawing a vertical streak on the finial. Refit only its power to preserve the prior base contribution.

socket_crescent.method: Overlapping physical spot emitters placed on reflected view rays; no geometry or material change.

socket_crescent_fit.method: Full colored wood BSDF response per real linked light, fit through AgX; fixed remaining rig, geometry and material.

socket_pigment_repair.method: Fill only the two exposed pigment imprints from adjacent log wood color; add bounded fine reference grain and medium relief-field variation. Preserve surrounding pigment and existing hidden-surface coverage.

stem_socket_receiver_isolation.method: Exact evaluated face partition with unchanged positions, UVs, normals and material. Exclude the measured stray reflectors only from stem/socket; preserve their action everywhere else.

collar_receiver_isolation.method: Exact evaluated collar faces; keep accepted socket, finial and remaining light behavior, excluding measured stray collar reflections.

collar_crescents.method: Overlapping physical spot emitters placed on reflected view rays; no geometry or material change.
collar_crescents.retained_basis: Copy the accepted reflectors and link copies only to collars, keeping their action everywhere else fixed.

collar_crescent_fit.method: Full colored wood BSDF response per real linked light, fit through AgX; fixed remaining rig, geometry and material.

glossy_interreflection.method: Keep actual BSDF direct diffuse/glossy lighting and four diffuse bounces; omit secondary glossy interreflection after diagnostic identified crown-body stripe as reflection of illuminated collars. An artistic render approximation, not a recovered original setting.

middle_collar_edge_refinement.method: Fill the lower bevel radially at three controls; retain all heights, maximum middle-collar radius, peak ring, all other controls, camera, UVs, pigment and lights. Regenerate every exact light receiver.

collar_surface_aim.method: Native emitted world positions and actual bump normals, averaged over same-surface 3x3 neighbors. At occluding edges use the nearest middle-collar pixel within three pixels; reference registration is unchanged.
